subtasks.description: Declare internal counter register and intermediate sd_clk_o signal with widths sufficient for the division ratio (counter width at least 8). Ensure port list matches S002 interface specification.
constraints: Port declarations must exactly match S002 IO ports.

subtasks.description: Implement a sequential process sensitive to CLK and RST: on asynchronous reset, clear counter and sd_clk_o to 0; on rising CLK edge, increment counter and toggle sd_clk_o when counter reaches DIVIDER, producing a divided clock.
Map the sd_clk_o signal to the top-level SD_CLK output using conditional compilation: in SIM, direct connect; in ACTEL, instantiate CLKINT buffer; SYN path remains open.
constraints: Output mapping must be purely combinational, with no added timing delays.
